what_it_is.prose:
Coimbatore-based drone avionics and propulsion-electronics company: V6X flight controller (company states designed and built in India), GNSS and power modules, ESCs and the YARI Atlas flight-data platform. Drone Expo 2026 exhibitor.

Value-chain position in the Atlas: Develops → Drone flight controller (L3); Develops → GNSS navigation modules (L3); Develops → Electronic speed controller (L3).

Evidence discipline: this record separates company claims from independent evidence. Classifications above carry their evidence level; the technology-origin class is 'UNKNOWN'. Exhibiting at Drone Expo 2026 establishes market presence only — not indigenous technology, Indian manufacturing, procurement or deployment.
